# Serenity Home Care

> Serenity Home Care is a clearly labeled demonstration website for a configurable non-medical home care provider in Dayton and surrounding communities. Business credentials, service availability, employment details, testimonials, and operating claims must be verified before a client launch.

## Primary pages

- [Home](https://mspixelpulse-demo-home-care.vercel.app/)
- [About](https://mspixelpulse-demo-home-care.vercel.app/about)
- [Services](https://mspixelpulse-demo-home-care.vercel.app/services)
- [Service areas](https://mspixelpulse-demo-home-care.vercel.app/service-areas)
- [Resources](https://mspixelpulse-demo-home-care.vercel.app/resources)
- [Request care](https://mspixelpulse-demo-home-care.vercel.app/request-care)
- [Contact](https://mspixelpulse-demo-home-care.vercel.app/contact)

## Content guidance

Educational content is general information only and is not medical, legal, or professional advice. Contact forms require server-side email configuration before accepting production leads.
